name: Derek Tran

items.why: This is opponents criticizing a lawyer for taking employment clients (his real work under criterion 4), with no finding or conduct by Tran that fails any criterion.

items.text: In May 2024 Tran told Punchbowl News that Michelle Steel "came to this country for economic gain," not as a refugee. In October her campaign mailed fliers linking him to Mao Zedong; he called them "dirty tricks." Sixteen Asian American nonprofits asked both Orange County parties to tone down rhetoric.
items.why: Tran's own words in a campaign dispute drew criticism, but no finding of wrongdoing was made and no criterion (1-6) clearly applies; the fliers and the letter are about Steel's campaign and both parties.

for_review: I couldn't read the original Politico reporting on Tran's employment clients. The Fox News and Rafu Shimpo pages cut off before the relevant passages, so item 1 rests on search snippets and campaign and NRCC releases, which are partisan. Those say Tran represented a former Safeway manager fired in 2019 over a noose and a Costco employee fired in 2021 after harassment complaints. I found no court finding or official record of misconduct by Tran. I used one search on the owner's named sites with Tran's name, and it returned nothing about him. I didn't check those sites directly. Nothing on attendance was weighed, as instructed. The Yahoo page is a syndicated copy of an LA Times story, and the Steel mailers and the nonprofit letter are not Tran's own conduct.
